what: CSV Upload Format and Validation Basics
title: Introduction to CodingManageR
text: can extend replace five database tables uploading CSV files: Scales (scale_definitions): required columns short_label, name, max_value (optional def_desc, bsp_0 bsp_4). Case Texts (texts): required column text (optional source_id). Sources Directory (sources): required columns Kurzreferenz, Vollstaendiges_Zitat (optional Lizenz, Lizenz_Details, URL_DOI). Ratings & Gold Standard (user_ratings): must match exported rating table columns (text_id, user_id, kategorie, typ, bewertung, etc.). Training Sessions (coding_training): must match exported training session structure. Follow rules avoid upload errors: Always start clicking Download CSV Template next corresponding upload field get empty file exact expected column headers. Format CSV files UTF-8 text using semicolon (;) column delimiter (comma). upload file, CodingManageR automatically cleans whitespace/BOM headers runs strict schema validation touching database. validation passes, two-step confirmation dialog lets choose whether append new records safely overwrite existing rows inside protected database transaction (rolling back automatically row fails).

what: Multi-User Qualitative Coding Portal and Training Manager
title: Multi-User Qualitative Coding Portal and Training Manager
text: CodingManageR multi-user R Shiny web application training portal qualitative text coding across ordinal scales. supports zero-configuration local SQLite databases single-user desktop sessions well pooled MariaDB/MySQL backends concurrent Open Source Shiny Server deployments.

title: Multi-User Qualitative Coding Portal and Training Manager
text: Stratified Coder Training & 16 Reliability Metrics: Draws balanced gold-standard training pools guaranteeing representation every discrete scale level (0..max_value) computes 16 inter-rater reliability classification metrics via aifeducation (including Cohen’s Kappa, Krippendorff’s Alpha, Gwet’s AC1/AC2, Iota2, Kendall’s W, Macro F1). Role-Based Live Coding Workspace: Enforces granular per-user permissions across coding scales, text corpora, scientific coding reference sources, automatic exclusion already-coded gold-standard cases. Personal Progress Dashboard: Tracks live codings, training sessions, interactive ggplot2 reliability trajectories across 16 metrics, Landis & Koch benchmark badges, searchable coding scale catalog. 8-Tab Administration Console: Manages users (token generation, active/inactive lockouts, permissions), texts, sources/licenses, ordinal scales, cross-coder reliability comparisons, rating corrections, schema-validated CSV imports/consolidated master exports, 9-table foreign-key integrity audit. Bilingual Localization: Built-German (de) English (en) interface automatic browser locale detection live header language switching.
